system.description: Go-betweens and trusted functionaries rise up in nearly every civilization where multiple groups attempt to cohabitate and work together. You're one such individual, be it an assistant to a leader, an emissary to a foreign people, or simply a courier who must pass through neighboring lands.
system.bonus: Bonus Proficiency: Culture. Stranger to the Land: You gain advantage on any Charisma Checks to hide your foreign nature.
